name: Timberling Sprout
summary: Along Lake Al'Ameth, Timberling Sprouts take root already touched by corruption. Night elf wardens pull them before they grow into aggressive timberlings.

sections.title: Blighted Seedlings
sections.body: Timberlings are plant spirits bound to Teldrassil's natural vitality. Along Lake Al'Ameth, the night elves find seedlings that sprout tainted and aggressive instead of healthy and in harmony with the wild. The young sprouts seem beyond cleansing or natural healing, so the caretakers gather and destroy them. They hope to stop hostile timberlings from spreading across the fragile boughs of the newly planted World Tree.

faq.answer: Timberling Sprouts grow near the water's edge along Lake Al'Ameth, south of Dolanaar in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why are night elves pulling Timberling Sprouts from the ground?
faq.answer: The sprouts emerge tainted. Left alone, they grow into violent timberlings that threaten Teldrassil's safety and balance. The caretakers consider them beyond help and remove them while they are still small.

faq.q: What is causing the sprouts to become tainted?
faq.answer: A mysterious sickness is affecting Teldrassil's wildlife and plant elementals. Botanist Denalan does not know its source, but it taints young timberlings from the moment they take root.

faq.q: Who asks for Timberling Sprouts to be collected?
faq.answer: Denalan, the botanist tending Lake Al'Ameth, asks adventurers to gather the sprouts and clear them from the lakeside to keep the land pure.

angles.text: As a druid attuned to Kalimdor's plant life and elementals, you may see woodland spirits emerging corrupted as a grim omen for Teldrassil's future.
As a young night elf training in Shadowglen, you are tasked with clearing the sprouts to safeguard your new woodland home.
